text:
Mira: Heads up team — we just crossed 42,000,000 requests this month! :tada: :confetti_ball:
Jon: wait what OMG nice :scream:
Priya: holy cow. huge congrats to runtime + infra :clap: :raised_hands:
Nina: love that. can we have a tiny in-office thing friday at 4pm? quick photos and snacks? :eyes:
Asha: I'm in for snacks. can we do dumplings AND mini cupcakes? democracy. :yum:
Mira: poll time — dumplings, cupcakes, or both? react with :dumpling: or :cupcake: or both if you can't choose.
Jon: :dumpling: (unapologetically)
Priya: :cupcake: but fine i'll accept both :grin:
DevBot: Deploy bot: Reminder — no infra changes scheduled Friday 3-5pm for celebration window.
Nina: perfect, thanks @DevBot. also can someone grab the mini confetti cannons from storage? (i promise to clean) :sweat_smile:
Asha: volunteering to be confetti cleanup crew. bring headphones for the playlist?
Mira: playlist idea — throw in one guilty-pleasure song each. i'll start: "Always Be My Baby" by Mariah Carey :notes:
Jon: adding "Uptown Funk" — sorry not sorry :musical_note:
Priya: shoutout to @SRE_Team and @runtime for the kv cache tweaks that saved us 15% cost. please take bows! :bow: :sparkles:
Nina: can someone take a quick photo of the team with the milestone banner? i'll upload to the socials channel after.
Mira: will do. tiny agenda: 4:00 snacks + photos, 4:20 30s shoutouts (whoever wants), 4:30 group pic and cake/dumpling attack. see y'all there! :party_popper:
Jon: bringing a disposable camera for retro vibes. also making a goofy banner: "42M little requests, 1 giant team" :laughing:
Priya: love it. proud of everyone.
Asha: best month yet. :heart:
